text:
nina: Quick report from the onboarding run of the new next-starter-lite: embedding step sometimes never resolves during SSR and the page stays stuck "loading". looks like a client+server retry interaction with auth failures.

omar: I reproduced this. SDK v0.10 client in browser keeps reattempting auth-refresh without exponential backoff, hitting 401s, and the server-side prewarm also fires so we end up with a race. logs: 
```
[2025-06-11T14:02:10.201Z] ERROR embed-worker AuthError: 401 Unauthorized: invalid_token
[2025-06-11T14:02:10.202Z] DEBUG sdk retry attempt=1 delay=50ms
[2025-06-11T14:02:10.253Z] DEBUG sdk retry attempt=2 delay=50ms
```

rachel: Ouch. Users will hit this on first-run demos. Short-term mitigation: in the starter README add env var note REDWOOD_API_KEY and a snippet to fallback to a queued background embed if SSR fails.

nina: For a fix we should: 1) ensure SDK honors maxRetries for auth errors, 2) make browser default retry policy conservative (backoff+jitter, lower cap), 3) add an optional per-request idempotency header for embeddings.

omar: I'll open a tiny PR that patches the retry strategy to treat auth errors like other transient errors (apply maxRetries + backoff) and add an env-detect default for retries. Will include a unit test mocking two 401s then a 200 and asserting at least one backoff interval elapsed.

ci-bot: CI triggered for branch sdk/auth-retry-adjust. Jobs: unit, integration. :gear:

rachel: Also adding an eval-harness check to the starter: if more than 1 embed API call is observed for a single demo session, fail the run. That should catch regressions.

qa-bot: Eval-harness run queued for branch sdk/auth-retry-adjust on lang-next-starter.

omar: PR description: "sdk: honor maxRetries for auth errors + conservative browser defaults". small changelog entry and migration notes about browser retry behavior.

nina: Thanks. Once merged I'll update the quickstart to show the sessionStorage debounce pattern + the queued background embed fallback snippet.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #601 (unit, integration). Merging shortly. :white_check_mark:

rachel: Verified merged branch locally; starter SSR now renders fallback on persistent auth failures and embedding completes when token refreshed. marking as addressed in onboarding checklist. :tada:
